label: Uneasy
summary: Sunday turned the Strait of Hormuz standoff into open exchange: the IRGC says it struck US-affiliated vessels and tankers after American forces destroyed three Iranian crude carriers. Oil finished the week near $91, up almost ten percent. Al Jazeera put the Lebanese death toll from Israeli attacks since 2023 at nearly 9,000, while Netanyahu defended the strike on Qatar. Anak Krakatau's eruption closed Jakarta's main airport, grounding 209 flights and stranding more than 22,000 passengers. More than 20 people died in a wedding-party fire in the DR Congo, and Germans voted in Saxony-Anhalt with the far-right AfD polling above 40 percent. Against that: Isar Aerospace put its Spectrum rocket into orbit from Norway, the first successful orbital launch from Western Europe, and a UN report at last named the 1.5C overshoot plainly. Danger leads; the progress is real but small.
